projects.title: Network Device Monitoring Dashboard
projects.description: A full-stack dashboard for monitoring network device uptime, availability, status, and performance metrics. Includes user authentication, RBAC, security logging, and device health visibility.

projects.title: Multi-Branch Enterprise Network
projects.description: Project showcasing full enterprise network design using Cisco Packet Tracer with centralized DHCP, DNS, and Web servers hosted at HQ. Static routing used for connectivity between HQ and branches.

projects.title: ARP Spoofing Detection & Defense System
projects.description:
A full ARP Spoofing detection and defense system using Python, Scapy, and Flask. 
Features real-time attack monitoring, dashboard visualization, alert sound, 
red flashing warnings, and automatic ARP table correction for victim devices.

projects.title: SOC Automation & Global Attack Map
projects.description:
Built an automated SOC simulation system that detects malicious IP activity, enriches it with geo-location data, logs events into Google Sheets, visualizes attacks on a global map, and automatically blocks attackers using Windows Firewall.
Technologies used: n8n, Python (Flask), Google Sheets API, Geo-IP APIs, Windows Firewall Automation, GitHub Pages.
projects.tags: Cyber Security, SOC, Automation, n8n, Python, Firewall
